description: Tidy a thread of the user's mail, as they would in yab's mail page: archive (out of the inbox; a thread they wait on is done waiting on too), inbox (back in), read, unread, star, unstar, spam (out of the inbox, as spam), snooze (out until `until`, an ISO date, or without it until someone writes), or label and unlabel (one of the user's labels, by its name as mail_read says it). Nothing is deleted or sent, and no label is made.

label.description: For label and unlabel: the label's name, as mail_read and mail_search say it

until.description: For snooze: when it comes back, ISO 8601

name: mail_act
title: Tidy Mail
